claims.gist: By 2027, 60% of organizations over 5,000 employees will have a formal AI governance function
Fewer than 20% of such organizations have a formal AI governance function today
41% of surveyed organizations reported at least one AI-related incident in 12 months
68% of respondents said their board asked for a formal AI risk report, up from 29%
Current AI oversight is mostly informal working groups without enforcement power
EU AI Act and state laws require documented risk assessments and human oversight
Governance should be an operating function with people, tooling and decision rights
Governance should measure approval speed as well as safety to avoid shadow AI

thesis: Sixty percent of large organizations will formalize AI governance by 2027, driven by regulation, incidents and board scrutiny.
